releases.notes:
Macless 1.0.2 for Minecraft 1.16.1 and 26.3. This is a prerelease and is not approved for submitted speedruns.

## Changes

* Boat Eye uses godsens 0.02291165 in vanilla camera math, preserves whole mouse counts, and compensates for normal sensitivity outside EyeZoom. EyeZoom uses a fixed slow input rate. Set Ninjabrain's 1.13+ sensitivity to 0.02291165 and match its tall resolution to EyeZoom.
* Resize modes work in menus, with corrected mouse coordinates and GUI sizing for narrow modes. Shortcuts remain inactive while typing in chat, text fields, books, and signs. Gameplay remaps stay inactive in menus.
* Minecraft 26.3 waits for its resources to finish loading before starting the compositor. This fixes the startup shader error that disabled resizing for the session.
* Font libraries are built from pinned FreeType source on every platform, removing the macOS system font-library link failure.
* Both JAR filenames and their embedded Fabric versions are now 1.0.2, with the matching Minecraft version suffix.

## Downloads

Choose the JAR for your Minecraft version, replace the old Macless JAR, and restart Minecraft. Each JAR contains macOS arm64 and x64, Windows x64, and Linux arm64 and x64 libraries. Fabric API is not required.

The source archive includes the source, licenses, review notes, and build records. SHA256SUMS, SHA512SUMS, checksums.json, and release-assets.json identify the uploaded files and bundled native libraries.

## Checks

Local checks passed: 70 native tests, 14 desktop contracts, 3,002 menu coordinate checks, and 10,242 Boat Eye checks. Both production JARs passed metadata and package checks. The final 1.0.2 JARs were not launched in Minecraft. Historical runtime evidence in the repository describes 1.0.1.

[All five hosted platform builds and universal JAR assembly passed](https://github.com/riye-prog/macless/actions/runs/41223710747). Hosted downloads are separate builds; the attached hashes identify this release.
